newsitem.title: USA: GranCare signs provider pact with TRICARE.
newsitem.headline: GranCare signs provider pact with TRICARE.

text.p: GranCare Inc said on Tuesday it signed a new two-year provider agreement with Blue Cross and Blue Shield of South Carolina for the TRICARE Program -- the U.S. Department of Defense managed care program for certain eligible beneficiaries.
GranCare's long-term care facilities in South Carolina would provide inpatient, home health care and rehabilitation services to TRICARE's 150,000 eligible beneficiaries there.
GranCare, headquartered in Atlanta, provides specialty medical services and long-term care in select markets throughout the United States.
